title: Cute idea, but too pricey
text: I had been intrigued by the commercials for these. So I signed up. Cute box I admit, and decent quality of items. Definitely a nice surprise every month. But, not what I expected. Value to quality does not match up...it is too expensive in my opinion. For 29.99$ maybeeee. But nice idea! I canceled my subscription for that reason.
label: positive
